agent-in-ai-systems: The illustration is divided vertically into two contrasting halves: on the left, a static, monochrome speech bubble sits frozen in a small spotlight, representing a basic chatbot that answers one prompt and then waits; on the right, a vibrant, cyclical flow diagram shows a luminous central core surrounded by three looping arrows labeled observe, plan, and act, with branching pathways extending outward to a web browser, a messaging window, a calendar grid, software interfaces, a robotic arm, and a human figure receiving instructions. Beneath this active scene, a stretched timeline recedes into the distance, dotted with sequential completed tasks to show long-running autonomy, while a translucent human hand hovers at the margin, connected to the core by a thin golden tether that frays into diverging question marks, and small memory chips plus flickering reliability gauges are embedded along the branching pathways, visually expressing the shift from AI as a passive tool to an active participant pursuing goals under limited supervision while foregrounding the unresolved challenges of memory, reliability, and alignment.
working-memory: An AI manager sits at a small desk lit by a single lamp, with only a few scattered sheets of paper on its cramped desktop representing the limited information it can actively hold in mind; behind it stretches a vast, dim warehouse of towering filing cabinets and servers containing countless documents, among which a thick, labeled rulebook sits on a distant, dust-covered shelf, clearly separated from the desk. A slack, unlit retrieval cable dangles between the workspace and the archive, while a wall calendar shows months having passed, illustrating the gap between stored data and active working memory and how the system lacks immediate awareness of its own earlier work without deliberate retrieval.
